rows.cypher:
MATCH (src:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[t:TRANSFER]->(tgt:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id, acct_no: $acct_no})
WITH src, sum(t.amount) AS total_sent
ORDER BY total_sent DESC
RETURN src.acct_no AS account_number, total_sent
LIMIT $limit
MATCH (a:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id}) WHERE a.acct_no = $acct_no RETURN a.owner_id AS owner_id LIMIT $limit
MATCH (a:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id, owner_id: $owner_id}) RETURN a.owner_id AS owner, count(a) AS total_accounts LIMIT $limit

MATCH (src:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[r:TRANSFER]->(dest:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id, acct_no: $acct_no})
RETURN count(r) AS incoming_transfers, sum(r.amount) AS total_amount
LIMIT $limit

MATCH (target:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id, acct_no: $acct_no})
MATCH (src:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[t:TRANSFER]->(target)
WHERE t.amount < $amount_max
RETURN count(t) AS inflows, sum(t.amount) AS total
LIMIT $limit

MATCH (a:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id, acct_no: $acct_no})-[:TRANSFER]-(b:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
MATCH (a)-[:USES_CHANNEL]->(c:Channel {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
RETURN c.code AS channel, count(*) AS transactions
ORDER BY transactions DESC
LIMIT $limit

MATCH (src:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id, acct_no: $acct_no})
MATCH (src)-[t:TRANSFER]->(dst:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
WITH dst.acct_no AS acct_no, sum(t.amount) AS total
ORDER BY total DESC
LIMIT $limit
RETURN acct_no, total

MATCH (a:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
WHERE a.acct_no = $acct_no
MATCH (a)-[:TRANSFER*1..2]->(dest:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
WHERE dest <> a
RETURN count(DISTINCT dest) AS reachable_count
LIMIT $limit

MATCH (a:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id, acct_no: $acct_no})
RETURN a.owner_id AS owner_id
LIMIT $limit

MATCH (l:Loan {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:DEPOSIT]->(start:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:TRANSFER*1..3]->(beneficiary:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id, acct_no: $acct_no}) RETURN count(DISTINCT l) AS loanCount LIMIT $limit

MATCH (owner:Person {_workspace_id: $workspace_id, id: $owner_id})
MATCH (a:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id, owner_id: $owner_id})
RETURN count(a) AS account_count
LIMIT $limit

MATCH (src:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[t:TRANSFER]->(beneficiary:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id, acct_no: $acct_no})-[:USES_CHANNEL]->(c:Channel {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
WHERE c.risk_weight >= $risk_weight
RETURN count(t) AS transfers, sum(t.amount) AS total
LIMIT $limit

MATCH (a:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
WITH a.owner_id AS owner_id, count(a) AS account_count
ORDER BY account_count DESC
RETURN owner_id, account_count
LIMIT $limit
MATCH (a:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id, owner_id: $owner_id}) RETURN a.acct_no AS acct_no LIMIT $limit

MATCH (src:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[t:TRANSFER]->(dst:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id, owner_id: $owner_id})-[:USES_CHANNEL]->(ch:Channel {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
WHERE ch.risk_weight >= $risk_weight
RETURN count(t) AS incoming_transfer_count
LIMIT $limit

MATCH (owner:Person {_workspace_id: $workspace_id, id: $owner_id})-[:OWN]->(a:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
MATCH (d:Medium {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:SIGN_IN]->(a)
RETURN count(DISTINCT d) AS device_count, count(*) AS sign_in_count
LIMIT $limit

MATCH (owner:Person {_workspace_id: $workspace_id, id: $owner_id})-[:OWN]->(a:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
MATCH (src:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[t:TRANSFER {_workspace_id: $workspace_id}]->(a)
WHERE t.amount < $amount_max
RETURN count(t) AS incoming_under_10000
LIMIT $limit

MATCH (src:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[t:TRANSFER]->(tgt:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id, acct_no: $acct_no})
WITH src, sum(t.amount) AS total_sent
ORDER BY total_sent DESC
RETURN src.acct_no AS account_number, total_sent
LIMIT $limit

MATCH (a:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id, acct_no: $acct_no})
RETURN a.owner_id AS owner_id
LIMIT $limit
MATCH (a:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id}) WHERE a.owner_id = $owner_id RETURN count(a) AS total_accounts LIMIT $limit

MATCH (a:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id}) WHERE a.acct_no = $acct_no
MATCH (src:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[t:TRANSFER]->(a)
RETURN count(t) AS incoming_transfers, count(DISTINCT src) AS distinct_senders
LIMIT $limit

MATCH (src:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})- [t:TRANSFER]-> (target:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id, acct_no: $acct_no}) WHERE t.amount < $amount_max RETURN count(t) AS inflows, sum(t.amount) AS total LIMIT $limit

MATCH (a:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id, acct_no: $acct_no})-[:USES_CHANNEL]->(c:Channel {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
OPTIONAL MATCH (a)-[t:TRANSFER]->()
RETURN c.code AS channel, count(t) AS txCount
ORDER BY txCount DESC
LIMIT $limit

MATCH (src:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id, acct_no: $acct_no})
MATCH (src)-[t:TRANSFER]->(dst:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
WITH dst.acct_no AS acct_no, sum(t.amount) AS total
ORDER BY total DESC
LIMIT $limit
RETURN acct_no, total

MATCH (start:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id, acct_no: $acct_no})
MATCH (start)-[:TRANSFER*1..2]->(reach:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
WHERE reach <> start
WITH collect(DISTINCT reach) AS accounts
RETURN size(accounts) AS distinct_account_count
LIMIT $limit
MATCH (a:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id, acct_no: $acct_no}) RETURN a.owner_id AS owner_id LIMIT $limit

MATCH (l:Loan {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:DEPOSIT]->(src:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:TRANSFER*1..3]->(benef:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id, acct_no: $acct_no})
RETURN count(DISTINCT l.id) AS loan_count
LIMIT $limit
MATCH (a:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id}) WHERE a.owner_id = $owner_id RETURN count(a) AS total_accounts LIMIT $limit

MATCH (beneficiary:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id, acct_no: $acct_no})<- [t:TRANSFER]-(src:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:USES_CHANNEL]->(ch:Channel {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
WHERE ch.risk_weight >= $risk_weight
RETURN count(t) AS transferCount, sum(t.amount) AS totalAmount
LIMIT $limit

MATCH (a:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
WITH a.owner_id AS owner_id, count(a) AS account_count
ORDER BY account_count DESC
RETURN owner_id, account_count
LIMIT $limit
MATCH (a:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id}) WHERE a.owner_id = $owner_id RETURN a.acct_no AS acct_no LIMIT $limit

MATCH (a:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id, owner_id: $owner_id})
MATCH (src:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:TRANSFER]->(a)
MATCH (src)-[:USES_CHANNEL]->(c:Channel {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
WHERE c.risk_weight >= $risk_weight
RETURN count(*) AS incoming_transfer_count
LIMIT $limit

MATCH (dev:Medium {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:SIGN_IN]->(acct:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
WHERE acct.owner_id = $owner_id
RETURN count(DISTINCT dev) AS device_count, count(*) AS sign_in_total
LIMIT $limit

MATCH (a:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id, owner_id: $owner_id})
MATCH (src:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[t:TRANSFER]->(a)
WHERE t.amount < $amount_max
RETURN count(t) AS incoming_transfers
LIMIT $limit

MATCH (src:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[t:TRANSFER]->(tgt:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id, acct_no: $acct_no})
WITH src, sum(t.amount) AS total_sent
ORDER BY total_sent DESC
RETURN src.acct_no AS account_number, total_sent
LIMIT $limit
MATCH (a:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id, acct_no: $acct_no}) RETURN a.owner_id AS owner_id LIMIT $limit
MATCH (a:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id, owner_id: $owner_id}) RETURN count(a) AS account_count LIMIT $limit

MATCH (a:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id, acct_no: $acct_no})
MATCH (src:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[t:TRANSFER]->(a)
RETURN count(t) AS transfer_count, sum(t.amount) AS total_amount
LIMIT $limit

MATCH (src:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})- [r:TRANSFER]-> (dest:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id, acct_no: $acct_no})
WHERE r.amount < $amount_max
RETURN count(r) AS inflow_count, sum(r.amount) AS inflow_total
LIMIT $limit

MATCH (a:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id, acct_no: $acct_no})-[:USES_CHANNEL]->(c:Channel {_workspace_id: $workspace_id}) RETURN c.code AS channel, count(*) AS transactions ORDER BY transactions DESC LIMIT $limit

MATCH (src:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id, acct_no: $acct_no})
MATCH (src)-[t:TRANSFER]->(dst:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
WITH dst.acct_no AS acct_no, sum(t.amount) AS total
ORDER BY total DESC
LIMIT $limit
RETURN acct_no, total

MATCH (a:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id, acct_no: $acct_no})
MATCH (a)-[:TRANSFER*1..2]->(dest:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
WHERE dest <> a
RETURN count(DISTINCT dest) AS reachable_accounts
LIMIT $limit
MATCH (a:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id, acct_no: $acct_no})-[:OWN]->(owner {_workspace_id: $workspace_id}) RETURN owner.id AS owner_id LIMIT $limit

MATCH (l:Loan {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:DEPOSIT]->(src:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
MATCH (src)-[:TRANSFER*1..3]->(benef:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id, acct_no: $acct_no})
RETURN count(DISTINCT l) AS loan_count
LIMIT $limit
MATCH (a:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id, owner_id: $owner_id}) RETURN count(a) AS total_accounts LIMIT $limit

MATCH (src:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:TRANSFER {_workspace_id: $workspace_id}]->(dst:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id, acct_no: $acct_no})
MATCH (t)-[:USES_CHANNEL {_workspace_id: $workspace_id}]->(c:Channel {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
WHERE c.risk_weight >= $risk_weight
RETURN count(t) AS transfer_count, sum(c.share) AS total_share
LIMIT $limit

MATCH (a:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
WITH a.owner_id AS owner_id, count(a) AS account_count
ORDER BY account_count DESC
RETURN owner_id, account_count
LIMIT $limit
MATCH (a:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id, owner_id: $owner_id}) RETURN a.acct_no AS acct_no LIMIT $limit

MATCH (a:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id, owner_id: $owner_id})-[:SIGN_IN]->(d {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
RETURN count(DISTINCT d) AS device_count, count(*) AS sign_in_total
LIMIT $limit

MATCH (owner:Person {_workspace_id: $workspace_id, id: $owner_id})-[:OWN {_workspace_id: $workspace_id}]->(account:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
MATCH (src:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[t:TRANSFER {_workspace_id: $workspace_id}]->(account)
WHERE t.amount < $amount_max
RETURN count(t) AS incoming_transfer_count
LIMIT $limit
